description: For concrete pour, this issue tracking log records pre-pour inspection, batch sequence, placement rate, consolidation, testing, joints, finishing, curing, and protection. Its supporting evidence includes delivery tickets, slump, air and temperature tests, cylinder log, placement photos, and curing observations.

title: Concrete Pour Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during concrete placement readiness and quality record when the concrete pour record must identify placement area, mix design, volume, reinforcement, embeds, forms, access, pump plan, weather, and finish class. Complete the applicable handoff for placed quantity, test sample custody, curing release, deficiency follow-up, finish acceptance, and record archive.
